summary.zh: 用 asyncio 编排并发与异步 I/O
summary.en: Structure concurrent and I/O-bound code with asyncio.

description.zh: 梳理 asyncio 的并发模型、任务调度和 async/await 写法，用来搭高吞吐的异步接口和 I/O 密集服务。开始写 async 端点、并发抓取或其他非阻塞任务时适合参考。
description.en: Explains the asyncio concurrency model, task scheduling and async/await patterns for high-throughput APIs and I/O-bound services. A good starting point for async endpoints, concurrent fetching or other non-blocking work.
